spec.claim_summary: Long ETH/USDT on 4h when price closes above the Ichimoku green lead line while it is above the red lead line, exiting when price closes below the green lead line.
spec.untestable_reason: The entry and exit depend entirely on Ichimoku lead lines, which cannot be expressed in the schema.

claimed.other: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin

assumptions: Asset ETHUSDT from claim phrase ETH/USDT.
Timeframe 4h from claim phrase four hour chart.
Direction interpreted as long from green-candle entry above lead line and red-candle exit below; claim never states long or short.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Ichimoku green and red lead lines and conditions based on them (green above red, closes above/below green lead line) - Ichimoku is not an available indicator and no substitute was used.
Claimed period 'beginning of 2017 until today' recorded as 2017-01-01 to 2021-06-02 posting date for context only; engine tests over all history.
